answer.book: Conrad Gesner's Bibliotheca universalis, Zurich 1574 edition enlarged by Josias Simler: an alphabetical catalogue of authors and their writings, preceded by a dedicatory epistle, addresses to the reader and a preface, and followed by a note on using the index, an index of names and a second address to the reader; the only numbered series is the eight tomes of Bullinger's works inside his catalogue entry.
